title: Peaks of Oceania (hard)
intro: 10 peaks of Oceania, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: Haleakalā
rounds.fact: Haleakalā has a recorded summit elevation of 3,055 m in the source data. The data places it in United States of America.
